subject: Summit visibility: studio footprint, on-site ops, and keynote confirmation
messages:
From: Elena Martinez <elena@summitworks.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jacob Li <jacob.li@partnermedia.io>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood Summit package — studio footprint and keynote slot

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the quick call today. Attached is the initial studio footprint PDF we discussed — it shows the demo studio, partner island, and the AV sightlines. A couple of clarifications for Redwood to confirm:

- Keynote slot availability: we have one prime keynote at 11:30am on Day 2 (45 mins). We can discuss moving to an earlier 10:00am slot but that would require an AV shift and a 30-minute Q&A cut.
- Logo placement: Platinum placement (main stage banner + website hero) is included; partner island logos are limited to one co-branded panel unless you upgrade to Platinum Plus.
- On-site build window: venue allows heavy builds between 06:00–10:00 on the morning of Day 2, AV rigging between 08:00–14:00.

I've looped Jacob from Partner Media to coordinate the shared demo times and any co-hosted panels. Please review the footprint and let me know if we should mark the 11:30 keynote as confirmed or propose the 10:00 adjustment.

Attachments: Studio_Footprint_Diagram.pdf

Best,
Elena Martinez
Sponsorship Director | SummitWorks
elena@summitworks.com
+1 415-555-0184
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@summitworks.com>
Cc: Jacob Li <jacob.li@partnermedia.io>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood Summit package — studio footprint and keynote slot

Thanks, Elena — the footprint looks good and aligns with what we sketched earlier. A few items from our side:

- We'd like to hold the 11:30am keynote if possible; it fits our executive calendar better. If the 10:00am move is required later, we can be flexible but prefer keeping the 45-minute slot.
- For logo placement: we want confirmation that our logo will appear on the main stage center panel (not just the website hero). Can you confirm exact dimensions/placement on the stage diagram?
- AV: confirm that the AV rigging window 08:00–14:00 gives you enough time to complete camera rehearsals before the 11:30 slot — our on-site tech lead will need a 30-minute run-through.

Also, two asks: can you add a co-hosted 30-minute breakout (Partner Theatre) adjacent to the partner island for demos? That would help our product team rotate demos without conflicting with the studio schedule. If that requires an uplift, flag it and we'll evaluate.

I've CC'd Kim to confirm marketing assets and Marissa for fulfillment.

Thanks —
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Field Marketing | Redwood Inference
hannah@redwoodinference.com
+1 650-555-0122
From: Elena Martinez <elena@summitworks.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jacob Li <jacob.li@partnermedia.io>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood Summit package — studio footprint and keynote slot

Hi Hannah,

Quick answers inline:

- Keynote: 11:30 remains available and we'll hold it tentatively. If you decide to move to 10:00 later, we can accommodate but the Q&A will be reduced to 30 minutes.
- Stage logo: confirmed — main stage center panel, 3ft x 5ft. We'll add a placement callout on the diagram (see updated link).
- AV rigging: 08:00–14:00 is fine; we'll reserve 09:30–10:00 for your tech run-through. Please confirm the on-site tech lead's contact.
- Partner Theatre: we can add a 30-minute slot next to partner island during the expo block for an additional $4,000 (includes basic AV and two dedicated demo stations).

I've attached the studio diagram with a stage callout and included a draft SOW for the Partner Theatre uplift. If you approve, I'll issue a DocuSign for the addendum and schedule Jacob to coordinate demo rotations.

Attachments: Studio_Footprint_Diagram.pdf (updated), SOW-draft-v2.docx

Best,
Elena Martinez
Sponsorship Director | SummitWorks
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Redwood Summit package — studio footprint and keynote slot

Kim / Marissa — forwarding the updated diagram and SOW. Key decisions needed:

1) Keep the 11:30am keynote (preferred) or agree to 10:00am if Summit requests it later?
2) Partner Theatre add-on at $4,000 — worth it to secure continuous demo throughput and reduce friction for product rotations?
3) Confirm our on-site tech lead: Will Wu (will@redwoodinference.com) will handle AV run-through at 09:30–10:00. Marissa, can you confirm booth staffing plan and whether we need extra headcount if we take Partner Theatre?

If we sign the addendum, we should also ask for a small marketing credit (social amplification + one extra pre-event email) in exchange for the extra spend. That helps justify budget.

Thoughts? I can reply to Elena with our decision and counter for a $2,500 credit if appropriate.

— Hannah
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood Summit package — studio footprint and keynote slot

Thanks Hannah — quick answers:

1) Hold 11:30. Execs prefer that time and we shouldn't ask them to move unless necessary.
2) Partner Theatre: agree it's valuable. Approve the $4k if we can get the marketing credit you proposed. Request the addendum include: one sponsored social post, one pre-event attendee email inclusion, and a logo feature in the Partner Theatre schedule card.
3) Booth staffing: Marissa, plan for three product demos rotating every 30 minutes (two staff per demo during peak hours). If Partner Theatre approved, add one floater (contractor) for the midday block.

If Summit pushes back on credit, counter with a $2,500 credit and request a Hall A directional banner.

Kim
From: Elena Martinez <elena@summitworks.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jacob Li <jacob.li@partnermedia.io>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Jul 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood Summit package — studio footprint and keynote slot

Hi all,

This is great — happy to confirm the 11:30 keynote hold and the Partner Theatre add-on at $4,000. We'll include the marketing items Kim requested (one sponsored social post, one pre-event attendee email slot, and the Partner Theatre schedule card logo). In good faith, I can also offer a $2,500 marketing credit instead of the Hall A banner (we typically reserve banners for Platinum Plus).

Next steps: I updated the SOW with the Partner Theatre line item and sent a DocuSign powerform (link below) for the addendum + signature on the SOW. Once signed, Jacob will set up the demo rotation spreadsheet and ops contact details.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcd-1234
Drive (updated diagram + SOW): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cStudioFootprint

Thanks — looking forward to having Redwood in the studio.
